blocks.text: Day 4 · Private transfer from the hotel to the airport and flight to Salta. On arrival, transfer to Cafayate (approx. 3 hours), the wine-producing town. Visit one of the main wineries, where your guide introduces you to the winemaking process: vine care, harvesting, ageing and bottling of different wines. Free time among the wineries and vineyards, lunch on the main square (not included) and a visit to the Wine Museum. Overnight in a wine hotel.

blocks.text: Day 5 · Breakfast at the hotel. Trip to Los Cardones National Park, en route to Salta, home to giant cacti 200 to 300 years old. Your guide tells you the legends of this mysterious place. After a few stops for photos and regional souvenirs, continue to Salta. Overnight in Salta.
